chapter: Package shows, Miami and the USO
title: New band at Delicate Pines
summary: Personnel: Freddy Jefferson on piano, Bobby Carroll replaced by a far-out trumpeter.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: At the Delicate Pines was this basically the same guys or was it different guys?
No, I had altogether different guys and I organized over. I had Freddy Jefferson on Piano, I still had Bobby Carroll.
You didn't have Willard Brown back?
No. I got this boy that later got a band of his own, a way out trumpet player.
You said you had Bobby Carroll.
Bob Carroll was drinking pretty bad by then?
